product_metadata.title: Great Bay Home Large Beach Towel Set of 2 - Nautical Beach Towels for Adults and Absorbent Velour Pool Towels with 100% Cotton - Lightweight Quick Dry Beach Towel Pack, 2 Pack - 30inch x 60inch
features: Resort, Luxury Swim Towels: Super soft, absorbent pool towels made from 100% genuine cotton for supreme comfort and luxury. These velour pool towels are thick while still quick-dry, so you won't miss a minute of sunshine waiting for these towels to dry.

Ultra Soft, Absorbent and Durable: Heavyweight, plush cotton provides ultimate softness, absorbency and durability for these velour beach towels. The plush, super soft cotton feels great on your skin. These swim towels are perfect for adults looking to relax in soft towels in the sun!

Beach Towel Prints: Soft cotton towels that feature vibrant colors and unique beach-inspired prints. These large towels are 30" x 60", perfect for adults & children. This collection features many colors like navy, blue, pink, orange, and red. With patterns featuring starfish, flamingos, fish, palm leaves, dolphins, and turtles.

Durable, Machine Washable, Easy Care: Durable cotton fibers make these pool towels last all season and more. These towels are easily machine washable in the cold cycle, and lightly tumble dry to keep them plush.
Customer Focused - At Great Bay Home we’re committed to helping resolve any issue and if you’re not completely satisfied with your beach towels our team will work with you to make things right
